title: How One Phone-Free Hour Shows a Godly Man What He Reaches For
caption:
Your hand knows what you trust before your mouth admits it.

Try one hour with the phone in another room. Watch where you reach, name what you were hunting, and take it to God by name.

What did your hand reach for last time you put it down?
